title: Isolate current-directory mutation in semantic path tests
description: Deep-dive audit 2026-08-08 verified that SemanticEmbeddingPathTests changes process-wide Directory.CurrentDirectory and restores it in teardown. Evidence: MemorySmith.Tests/SemanticEmbeddingPathTests.cs lines 23-129. Replace with injected path resolution or process isolation; do not rely only on non-parallelizable fixture scope.
